light.why: the key light of scene.py (itself a PLACEHOLDER); weights the diffraction

white_balance.why: set cooler than the light, as a photographer would, so that the glaze (its measured colour, a grey green) comes out the original's grey blue: object mean (112,127,145) against (117,134,150), S2 preview

expose.why: our choice: the brightest highlights half a stop under clipping, as a careful photographer exposes

develop.why: contrast fitted with the lights' strengths (scene.py, S2) to the original's frame 103: luma blurred 40 px over the object (median, 90th percentile), the hotspot and the sky; its darkest tenth is its own dark glaze, weighted lightly
